deposits.notes: Article-only institutional deposit, not a participant-data deposit. The lead came from retrieval.json and was followed during the repository search (found_by=search). The DSpace bundles API https://upcommons.upc.edu/server/api/core/items/14fd6f9d-ec0a-4efb-82c3-6b3aa0158822/bundles returned HTTP 200 and four bundles. All four bitstream-list endpoints returned HTTP 200: ORIGINAL: https://upcommons.upc.edu/server/api/core/bundles/636a7b73-a077-4b0e-81ed-3703621df7a8/bitstreams; LICENSE: https://upcommons.upc.edu/server/api/core/bundles/455e287c-8b5b-4c58-9ed9-b380a910042b/bitstreams; THUMBNAIL: https://upcommons.upc.edu/server/api/core/bundles/5e747aa2-2e71-48a3-92a4-eddb86f65939/bitstreams; TEXT: https://upcommons.upc.edu/server/api/core/bundles/106efe17-2c37-4236-8224-6196219230a1/bitstreams. Each bundle contained one file, so n_files includes the article, repository license, thumbnail, and extracted article text. The public PDF link https://upcommons.upc.edu/bitstreams/8313254c-e035-4258-9bc4-54758828ceb9/download returned HTTP 200 and 977353 bytes; it was opened in memory, has 17 pages, and contains the same on-request data statement. The boolean fields refer to participant/output records with usable identifiers: the article describes the arms and prints aggregate outcome statistics and illustrative prompt quotations, but supplies no participant-to-arm mapping, individual score table, or full corpus of ideas/texts. No analysis code or separate experimental materials are listed. This public article does not change the data-availability status to public_partial.

notes: Read all 92166 characters of the markdown conversion in contiguous chunks, including the complete references, and inspected the PDF's link inventory and p. 15 with PyMuPDF. The 17-page document has no appendix and no embedded files. The quoted sentence is the sole availability statement; no c031 repository, code-sharing, materials-sharing, preregistration, or supplementary-file statement/link was identified. The form's data_and_code.data_url and code_url are both empty. The only OSF-related DOI in the paper is https://doi.org/10.31234/osf.io/8p9wu (References, p. 16), which returned HTTP 200 and redirected to https://osf.io/8p9wu; it cites Moon, Green, and Kushlev's separate PsyArXiv paper and is not a c031 deposit. Bibliographic citations, journal navigation, author profiles, and article-license links are not treated as study-data links. No public participant-level or participant-linked output data for S1 were confirmed. The institutional article copy adds no data with which to resolve final.open_items: S1-O7/S1-O8 direction, analysis units/degrees of freedom and implemented semantic-divergence definition; S1-O10 category level; or the other undocumented scoring/word-counting and sample-overlap questions. No additional participant means, SDs, SEs, analyzed counts, or diversity measures can be obtained from a newly discovered dataset. The design caveat for S1-O12 through S1-O15 remains as recorded in the form. The explicit on-request statement supports the status; confidence in ruling out an unmentioned public deposit is limited by the publisher's HTTP 403 and the OSF endpoint's title-only search. No access request, account creation, authentication, or CAPTCHA/bot-check bypass was attempted. Network checks used Python urllib with User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1; downloads were held in memory. The only deposit counted here is the article-only UPCommons record.
